breakfast.name: Turkey sausage egg muffins
ingredients: 6 oz fully cooked turkey breakfast sausage, chopped
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Divide the sausage, spinach, and bell pepper among the cups.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then pour into the cups about three-quarters full.
Top with the mozzarella and bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center.
Cool, then refrigerate in a sealed container.
To serve, microwave 2 muffins per person for 45 to 60 seconds and eat with a clementine or two.

lunch.name: Berry-ginger smoothie
ingredients: Optional: 1/2 frozen banana, a squeeze of lemon, or a few ice cubes
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, spinach, berries, ginger, almond butter, and flaxseed.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Sesame salmon + broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the broccoli and pepper with the olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 10 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, ginger, and garlic.
Push the vegetables to the sides, add the salmon skin-side down, and brush with the sauce.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily (145 F).
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onion and serve.

breakfast.name: Blueberry-almond oats
steps: The night before, whisk almond milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Stir in the oats, chia seeds, and frozen blueberries, divide between two jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, add a splash of milk if thick, and top with the sliced almonds.

dinner.name: Turkey taco lettuce cups
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion and pepper 3 minutes.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, 5 to 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and 1/2 tsp salt, then the beans and salsa. Simmer 3 minutes.
Spoon into romaine leaves and top with avocado, a little Greek yogurt, and a squeeze of lime.

dinner.name: Garlic shrimp + white beans
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp 1 to 2 minutes per side until pink. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic and pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then the beans, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer 4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, return the shrimp, and add the juice of half the lemon.
Serve topped with Parmesan and lemon wedges.

dinner.name: Thanksgiving turkey breast
ingredients: 1 boneless turkey breast roast (about 3 lb), thawed
1 medium sweet potato, cut in 1-inch cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F. Pat the turkey dry and let it sit out 20 minutes.
Mix the butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, poultry seasoning, 1 tsp salt, and pepper, and rub it all over the turkey.
Set the turkey in the middle of a large rimmed sheet pan, pour the broth into the pan, and roast 30 minutes.
Toss the Brussels sprouts and sweet potato with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper and spread them around the turkey.
Roast 45 to 60 minutes more, until the thickest part of the turkey reads 160 F and the vegetables are browned.
Tent with foil and rest 15 minutes (it will reach 165 F), then slice.
Serve about 6 oz turkey each with the vegetables and 2 tbsp cranberry sauce. Refrigerate the rest of the turkey within 2 hours.

dinner.name: Leftover turkey stir-fry
ingredients: 12 oz leftover turkey, cut in bite-size pieces
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Microwave or pan-cook the cauliflower rice according to the bag and keep warm.
Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat and stir-fry the snap peas and pepper 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, and most of the green onions for 30 seconds, then add the turkey and toss until hot, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and cornstarch mixture and cook 1 minute until glossy.
Serve over the cauliflower rice with the rest of the green onions.

breakfast.name: Smoked salmon scramble
ingredients: 3 oz smoked salmon, torn into pieces
steps: Whisk the eggs with a little pepper (the salmon is salty, so skip the salt).
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and wilt the spinach for 1 minute.
Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula until softly set, 2 to 3 minutes.
Fold in the smoked salmon and green onions off the heat, and serve with the clementines.

lunch.name: Leftover turkey salad
ingredients: 8 oz leftover Thanksgiving turkey, sliced or chopped
Any leftover roasted Brussels sprouts or sweet potato
steps: Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the spinach and apple and toss to coat.
Divide between two plates and top with the turkey, any leftover vegetables (warm or cold), cranberries, pecans, and feta.

dinner.name: Chicken cacciatore skillet
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the chicken 4 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Add the mushrooms, pepper, and onion and cook 5 minutes until softened, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and pepper flakes, and nestle the chicken back in.
Cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 175 F.
Stir the spinach into the sauce until wilted and serve topped with Parmesan.

breakfast.name: Cottage cheese bowls + eggs
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple chunks (canned in juice, drained)
8 large eggs (4 for now, 4 for lunch)
steps: Cover the 8 eggs with cold water in a pot, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, divide the cottage cheese between two bowls and top with pineapple, almonds, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Move the eggs to ice water for 2 minutes. Peel 4 and serve 2 per person; refrigerate the other 4 for lunch.

lunch.name: Greek chickpea egg salad
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion and toss.
Divide between two bowls and top with the eggs and feta.

dinner.name: Dijon pork + carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the carrots with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 10 minutes.
Mix the Dijon, remaining oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt, and pepper and rub it over the pork.
Push the carrots aside, add the pork and green beans to the pan, and roast 18 to 22 minutes until the pork reaches 145 F.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the vegetables.
